Hi Jordan / Priya —

Thanks again for the call today — great context on the search & triage assistant you want to surface in the agent UI. To make the POC high signal, here are the next steps I propose so we can surface a focused evaluation and clear success criteria: 

1) Customer deliverables (by next Tue 8/25):
   - Sample prompt set (50–200 canonical prompts across intents) — CSV or JSONL OK. Please include expected/acceptable outputs where possible.
   - Chat logs / interaction traces (anonymized) for the top 3 most common flows (search, summarize, triage). We only need representative ~500–1,000 turns.

2) Redwood deliverables (during week of 8/26):
   - Ingest prompts/logs, run baseline eval across 2 model variants, provide per-intent quality metrics and latency/throughput numbers.
   - Suggested production config: batching/caching + quantization profile.

3) Success criteria (draft):
   - Precision: >= 85% on intent classification for triage prompts (customer-provided labels)
   - Latency: 95th percentile <= 250ms for short prompts (API p95)
   - No major safety/regression failures on sensitive intent tests

4) Ownership / contacts:
   - Customer POC lead: Jordan Lee (you) — will own dataset delivery and legal approvals
   - Redwood: Marissa Cole (sales) / Dev Patel (SE) / Rishi Malhotra (CS)

5) Logistics: please upload files to the Drive link below or reply with attachments. If you have security constraints we can set up a temporary SFTP or sign an NDA — let me know.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cAcmeHealth-POC

Attached is a short template (redwood_poc_template.csv) for prompts & an eval matrix we typically use (poc_eval_matrix.xlsx). If you prefer, we can collect the prompts via a quick Google Form.

Would love confirmation on timeline and any constraints (PII, encryption, redaction).

Thanks —

Thanks Marissa / Jordan —

Quick technical notes from the SE side: 

1) Prompt file expectations (redwood_poc_template.csv):
   - columns: prompt_id, intent_label, prompt_text, expected_output (optional), tags
   - UTF-8 CSV; if you have multiline prompts please quote the field.

2) Chat logs format (JSONL):
   - Each line: {"session_id":"...","turns":[{"role":"user","text":"..."},{"role":"assistant","text":"..."}],"metadata":{...}}
   - If you cannot share metadata fields, we can accept minimal: session_id + turns array.

3) Security / access:
   - For ingestion we can work with Drive upload; if you prefer, we can accept an SFTP drop with short-term credentials.
   - Please redact or replace PHI tokens; if you need, we can run the ingestion on-prem with your team.

4) Evaluation specifics — we propose we compute the following automatically: 
   - Intent accuracy (per-intent and aggregate)
   - Appropriateness pass rate (binary) on curated eval prompts
   - BLEU / ROUGE are optional; more relevant for long-form summarization flows
   - Latency: p50/p95 per model variant at realistic batching

5) Acceptance criteria — please confirm, but typical thresholds we suggest for a productive POC:
   - Intent accuracy >= 85%
   - Appropriateness pass rate >= 80% on curated prompts
   - p95 latency <= 250ms on the selected variant (on our dedicated test infra)

I'll attach the loader and a small sample conversion script. Also proposing the kickoff Monday 8/26 10am PT — I'll be on the call to walk through ingestion.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
